description: Regional Heterogeneity of Household Electricity Consumption in Portugal: Evidence from Smart Meter Data and Energy Surveys Dataset_SM_EnergySurveys is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Evandro Ferreira, Pedro Palma (Universidade Nova de Lisboa Centro de Investigação em Ambiente e Sustentabilidade). Regional Heterogeneity of Household Electricity Consumption in Portugal: Evidence from Smart Meter Data and Energy Surveys Regional and aggregated databases; Utilised code (Random Forest + SHAP techniques); Supplementary material. Coverage: national (PT); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
